R1.topic: پیری و حافظه: از جزئیات به معنا
R1.central_tension: همه فکر می‌کنیم با پیری حافظه فقط فرسوده می‌شود؛ ولی شاید ذهن جزئیات را رها می‌کند تا معنا را نگه دارد.
R1.working_hook: مادربزرگ تاریخ را یادش نیست. ولی یادش است آن سال چه چیزی یاد گرفت.
R1.framing_note: C01 is a hypothesis paper, C02 a small unpreregistered study (n=74). Say 'یک فرضیه‌ی تازه' once; do not present as proven. Not about Alzheimer's; mention that disease is a different path only if needed.

key_sources.publisher: ScienceDaily (Association for Psychological Science release; University of Arizona)
key_sources.claim: Theory paper (Fernandez, Burke, Nadel, Perspectives on Psychological Science, DOI 10.1177/17456916261469175) proposes age-related shift from hippocampal detail to frontal 'gist/meaning' may be developmental adaptation, not only decline; disrupted in Alzheimer's.

Psychology and Aging (Melega ... Renoult, UEA): 37 older vs 37 younger adults; older adults' memories had more semantic/general detail (e.g. 40-42% vs 15-24% in categoric memories), rated specific memories more vivid; senior author argues style may be adaptive. Small, not preregistered, mostly female.

R1.image_note: No source image needed: abstract idea; no product/place/artwork. Never use photos of private individuals. Vector motion (shift, focus, noise->clarity) serves better.

R2.topic: لوگویی که صدا ساخت: هویت تازه‌ی اپل موزیک
R2.central_tension: ما لوگو را چیزی می‌دانیم که طراح می‌کشد؛ اپل موزیک لوگویش را از خودِ محصولش، یعنی صدا، بیرون کشید.
R2.working_hook: این لوگو را کسی نکشید. یک نُت موسیقی آن را ساخت.
R2.framing_note: Process facts from Wallpaper*/AppleInsider (oil tank, transducer, in-camera). Black-and-white instead of red: attribute to MacRumors only. Takeaway for small brands: find the identity in what you actually make, not in decoration. Do not claim results/metrics.

key_sources.claim: Apple Music identity built from music played into a shallow bath of mineral oil and filmed; new wordmark (Apple symbol + customised SF Pro, bold lowercase), reworked note icon; sonic signature composed with Fred again.. and Nest Acoustics.
Apple introduced the identity on 21 Oct after new logo (6 Oct) and icon (13 Oct); visuals black-and-white instead of red; rollout with iOS 27.2/macOS 27.2.
Logo etched into glass floor of a mineral-oil tank; transducer played chosen tones; filmed in-camera, not CGI; used as sting before Apple Music videos; debuted at Apple Music Hall, Battersea.
